content.title: How to watch live TV on Hulu: Price, plans, features
content.text: Hulu + Live TV combines Hulu's on-demand service with live streaming channels. Hulu/Facebook Updated Oct 21, 2025, 4:05 PM UTC Hulu + Live TV is a great way to access live TV channels and multiple popular streaming services under one bundle price. The flagship plan costs $90 a month and includes over 95 channels, as well as access to Disney Plus, Hulu's on-demand catalog, and the ESPN streaming service for no extra charge.Instead of waiting until the next day to watch new episodes of "The Bachelor" or "9-1-1," Hulu + Live TV lets you stream shows as they air. This makes Hulu + Live TV a convenient alternative to cable and satellite packages that often cost more.A recent price hike brought Hulu + Live TV's base plan up from $83 a month to $90 a month, and increased the ad-free bundle option from $96 a month to $100 a month. However, until 3 p.m. PT / 6 p.m. ET on November 5, 2025, Hulu + Live TV is offering a deal on its base plan with the ad-supported Disney bundle. Instead of $90 a month, eligible customers can get their first three months for $65 a month. After that point, subscribers will begin getting charged at the standard rate unless they cancel before the three months are up. Given the recent price hike, that's nearly 28% off the first few months of service.If you're considering signing up, here's a full breakdown of how to watch live TV on Hulu, along with details on pricing and features. And if you're interested in any of Hulu's other plans, check out our full guides detailing how much Hulu costs and the best Hulu bundles. Hulu + Live TV Hulu + Live TV includes over 95 channels, along with Hulu's on-demand library and access to Disney Plus and ESPN Select. Adding live TV drives up the price significantly, but it's a rolling one-month contract that you're free to cancel at any time. How much is Hulu + Live TV?Hulu + Live TV starts at $90 a month. This plan includes ad-supported access to Hulu's entire streaming catalog, over 95 live channels, and full access to ad-supported Disney Plus and ESPN Select. If you want ad-free access to the Hulu and Disney Plus on-demand catalogs, you need to upgrade to Hulu (No Ads) + Live TV for $100 a month. There's also a bare-bones version called Live TV Only that costs $89 a month and doesn't include Hulu's on-demand streaming catalog or Disney Plus.Hulu + Live TV pricing and plansWhat channels come with Hulu + Live TV?Hulu + Live TV offers more than 95 channels. The lineup features local networks in many markets, including ABC, CBS, Fox, and NBC. Hulu also has live sports, news, and entertainment via major networks like ESPN, FX, CNN, Cartoon Network, Disney Channel, Bravo, Paramount Network, History, Discovery, Food Network, and more. Though the service includes many of the most popular cable stations, there are two notable exceptions: Hulu + Live TV does not support AMC or NBA TV.Check out our roundup of Hulu + Live TV channels to see a full list of included networks. Channels are often subject to sudden change or regional variability, so it's a good idea to look at exactly what's available in your plan before signing up.What features does Hulu + Live TV support?All Hulu + Live TV users can access unlimited cloud DVR at no extra cost. With unlimited cloud DVR, you can record as many episodes of your favorite TV shows as you want. Each program you record will be available for on-demand playback for up to nine months after the recording date. Playback for recordings includes the option to fast-forward and rewind. Hulu + Live TV also includes support for streaming on two screens simultaneously. For an extra $10 a month, you can upgrade to Unlimited Screens, which allows you to watch as many simultaneous Hulu streams as you want, as long as the devices are connected to the WiFi network you've designated your "home network." With the Unlimited Screens upgrade, subscribers can also stream on up to three mobile devices on-the-go, or outside of the home WiFi network.How do I sign up for Hulu + Live TV?If you're not already subscribed to one of Hulu's on-demand plans, signing up for Hulu + Live TV is a simple process. Here's a rundown of how to sign up:1. Visit the Hulu + Live TV website.2. Click on the sign-up link and enter your info to make an account.3. Provide a credit card number or use a PayPal account for payment.4. After submitting payment, you'll be billed the regular monthly fee.5. You can now access Hulu + Live TV through the Hulu app or website with your account.If you're already an existing subscriber to one of Hulu's on-demand plans, upgrading to the Hulu + Live TV service is also simple:1. Visit the Hulu website and log in to your account.2. Hover over the account icon at the top right of the page.3. Click on "Account" and select the "Manage Plan" option.4. Choose the Hulu + Live TV plan of your choice.Is there a Hulu + Live TV free trial?New members can usually get a free three-day trial of the Hulu + Live TV base plan, although this is often not available when there's a deal. Once the free trial is over, your subscription will automatically renew for $90 a month unless you cancel. The more expensive ad-free on-demand plan does not currently come with a free trial. For more details, check out our Hulu Live TV free trial guide. Can I get Hulu + Live TV with the Disney Plus and ESPN bundle?Hulu + Live TV memberships include the Disney Plus bundle with on-demand Hulu, Disney Plus, and ESPN Select as part of a subscription. Subscribers will also be able to access ESPN Unlimited via the ESPN app by logging in with their MyDisney information. The bundle adds a lot of value to Hulu + Live TV and all three on-demand platforms make our list of the best streaming services you can sign up for. What add-ons can I get with Hulu + Live TV?Hulu + Live TV offers extra channel bundles and premium channel add-ons. Premium channelsFor an extra monthly fee, you can add streaming access to a premium network. All of these add-ons come with movies and television shows that are exclusive to each service:HBO Max with Ads ($11/month)HBO Max without Ads ($18.49/month)Paramount Plus with Showtime/Premium ($13/month)Cinemax ($10/month)Starz ($11/month)Entertainment add-onFor $8 a month, you can add access to these 16 channels: American Heroes ChannelBET HerBoomerang ChannelCooking ChannelCrime + InvestigationDestination AmericaDiscovery FamilyDiscovery LifeHallmark DramaMilitary History ChannelNicktoonsMTV2MTV ClassicScienceTeenNickEspañol add-onFor $5 a month, gain access to nine Spanish-language channels: CNN en EspañolDiscovery en EspañolDiscovery FamiliaESPN DeportesFOX DeportesHistory Channel en EspañolHogar de HGTVNat Geo MundoNBC UniversoSports add-onFor $10 a month, you can watch hours of sports with:FanDuel RacingNFL RedZoneOutdoor ChannelRACERSportsman ChannelStrike ZoneTennis ChannelWhat devices can I stream Hulu + Live TV on? Hulu + Live TV is available on smart TVs, phones, tablets, game consoles, and streaming devices. Ted Soqui/Contributor/Getty Images Most smart TVs and media players support the Hulu app, so once you sign up online, you'll be able to stream instantly. You can also stream the service through the Hulu mobile app or the Hulu website.You can find a full list of devices that support Hulu + Live TV on Hulu's website. And if you're looking for a new display or media player that supports Hulu, check out our guides to the best TVs and best streaming devices. Do I need an antenna to watch Hulu + Live TV?Hulu + Live TV does not require an indoor TV antenna. You will not need any additional external equipment other than a supported streaming device like a smartphone or smart TV.Can I watch live TV on multiple devices?With the Unlimited Screens add-on ($10/month), you can watch most live TV stations on an unlimited number of devices at home and three on the go. However, premium channel add-ons are restricted to a total of five simultaneous streams, even with the Unlimited Screens add-on. Can I record live TV on Hulu?Yes, Hulu + Live TV subscribers can use the service's Cloud DVR feature to record shows.
